title: The QR-code APK download — question explanation
learningObjective: Assess app-store provenance and permission scope when QR prompts an app install
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A QR code on a delivery notice opens a page asking you to download an Android package file directly because the “official app store is unavailable.”
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Assess app-store provenance and permission scope when QR prompts an app install
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option A: Do not sideload it; verify the delivery through the courier’s official app or independently located website. Use an authenticated distribution channel and independently verify the delivery request.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option B: The printed notice does not authenticate the source or integrity of the installation file. Option C: This transfers risk to another person and may propagate malware. Option D: One permission choice does not make an untrusted package safe; it may request more later or contain malicious code.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Close the page, do not install the package, and verify shipment status through the courier’s independently accessed official service. Do not install an unsolicited app package from a QR-linked page; use a trusted app distribution channel.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Do not install an unsolicited app package from a QR-linked page; use a trusted app distribution channel.
